sources.title: GitHub - KUNDANPATIL25/skindiseaseprediction-
sources.snippet: This project uses a DINOv2-base model fine-tuned on skin disease classification dataset, achieving ~95.6% accuracy on 31 classes of skin diseases. The model is based on the work: Enhancing Skin Disease Classification Leveraging Transformer-Based Deep Learning Architectures and Explainable AI
